description: Share of 30d with a scheduled run inside the last two days. A heartbeat, not a ratio: 26 traces in 30d against a 97% target is an error budget of 0.78 events. The workflow emits a span on every run including fully cached ones (RC1-442 routes Previews Needed? into Build LLM Spans), so absence of a span means absence of a run.
name: Concert intelligence run freshness
